build_azure_realtime_url: build a WebSocket URL for Azure OpenAI realtime endpoint with GA or beta protocol support
create_azure_realtime_connection: create an async WebSocket connection to Azure OpenAI realtime API with SSL and authentication
forward_azure_realtime_messages: forward realtime WebSocket messages bidirectionally between client and Azure OpenAI backend
run_azure_realtime_streaming: run bidirectional realtime streaming between a client websocket and Azure OpenAI backend
test_azure_realtime_handler: test the AzureOpenAIRealtime handler for WebSocket connection, URL construction, and message forwarding
